description: Add a competitor to a workspace by homepage URL and start discovering its pricing, docs, blog, and changelog pages. Discovery is async: poll get_competitor until discovery_status is completed. Re-adding the same URL returns the existing competitor. Returns 409 with active_competitor_id while another discovery runs in the workspace. To watch one specific page, use create_monitor.

monitor_types.description: Only discover these page types. Omit to discover all of them.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from list_workspaces or create_workspace

name: add_competitor
title: Add competitor
